environment.description: NestJS catalog microservice deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'catalog-frontend'. Service is exposed via Istio ingress gateway with default permissive mTLS. No AuthorizationPolicy resources applied. The service mesh sidecar (envoy) passes all traffic including cross-namespace requests. External traffic reaches the service through the ingress gateway with X-Forwarded-Host header preserved from client requests. No header sanitization at the gateway level.
